findings.current: a monster who has forsaken filial duty
findings.defect: “Monster” intensifies 패륜아, which condemns the son as unfilial but does not itself call him a monster.
findings.rationale: The source says someone may call a son who kills his father 패륜아. “An unfilial son” preserves that accusation without adding the stronger image of a monster.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful. One minor wording choice makes the condemnation stronger than the Korean source states.
